description: This Java class implements a content repository that stores files and images on the filesystem, including methods for saving, deleting, and fetching files and images, with support for Base64 encoded images and directory management.

classes.name: FileSystemContentRepository
classes.description: A component that manages storing, retrieving, and deleting files and images on the filesystem, with support for directory creation and path sanitization.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to the filesystem at a generated directory path based on entity type and ID.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves an image input stream to the filesystem at a generated client image directory.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves a Base64 encoded image to the filesystem after decoding.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image file at the specified location.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file at the specified document path.

methods.name: fetchFile
methods.description: Retrieves file data from the filesystem based on document data.

methods.name: fetchImage
methods.description: Retrieves image data from the filesystem based on image data.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type as FILE_SYSTEM.

methods.name: generateFileParentDirectory
methods.description: Generates directory path for storing a document based on entity type and ID.

methods.name: generateClientImageParentDirectory
methods.description: Generates directory path for storing client images based on resource ID.

methods.name: makeDirectories
methods.description: Creates parent directories for a given path if they do not exist.

methods.name: writeFileToFileSystem
methods.description: Writes an input stream to the specified file location, creating directories as needed.
